body.p: A fox was going and going, it met a bear. It was dark. The fox said to the bear: "Let's lie down to sleep on a rock, on a clearing". The bear agreed, the fox said: "When I say 'higher', then move up", so they fell asleep. When it became midnight, the fox jumped up to the peak and said: "Higher, higher!" The bear didn't understand it while sleeping and rolled the rock down, it died. The fox ate its intestines, it made sausage. Then it went off, it was going and going, it saw a wolverine that was making skis out of boards. The fox stuck the sausage in its mouth. The fox said: "I am eating my tongue, it's tasty, well, try it". The wolverine ate it and said: "Tasty". Then the wolverine gnawed at its own tongue, it died. The fox went along the trace of the wolverine. It took its [= the wolverine's] skis. It came to its [= the wolverine's] house. When it turned dark, the fox lay down to sleep with the wolverine's wife. The wolverine's wife said: "Why are you so agile?" Its [= the wolverine's] boys considered it strange, they began to beat it. When beating so, they chopped their mother, [but] the fox dodged. Until now the wolverine is short.
